story_type: crewed launch, then the booster flies back and lands
hook: Four people rode this rocket up. The bottom half came back alone.
narration: Four people rode on top of this rocket. Then the bottom half flew home without them.
Crew-13 lifted off from Cape Canaveral on October first, 2026, bound for the space station.
A Falcon 9 first stage only does the first part of the climb, then separates and steers itself back.
[short pause] So the booster came down tail first, firing its engine to slow its fall.
outcome: The booster landed upright, and all four astronauts reached the space station.
title: Crew-13 launch and booster landing
description:
A Falcon 9 launches the four-person Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, Oct. 1, 2026, and its first stage returns to land.

Footage: U.S. Space Force video by Staff Sgt. Spencer Contreras, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1025626
